description: Research-only Agent Adda skill card for assessing the Indian equity market over the last 3 months, covering broad index regime, stage distribution changes, sector leadership from stage and VCP evidence, and liquid Stage 2 swing candidates.

evidence_required.market: Indian listed equities and Indian market indices only
evidence_required.minimum_window: Last 3 calendar months ending on the requested as_of_date or latest available trade_date
required_filters: Use market.index_eod for index-level price, trend, RSI, momentum, relative strength, and trading signal evidence.
Use scores.stage_snapshots for stage distribution, sector mix, market cap category, technical score, relative strength, and stance evidence.
Use scores.stage2_vcp_picks for ranked Stage 2 VCP candidate evidence.
Use market.equity_eod for recent price, turnover, volume, delivery, and market cap liquidity context for candidate symbols.

input_patterns: find swing candidates from recent sector rotation
market regime and stage 2 leadership over 3 months

sql_templates.description: Read-only index evidence for broad Indian market regime over the last 3 months.
sql_templates.name: index_eod_3m_regime
sql_templates.template: SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, open, high, low, close, prev_close, change_pct, volume, turnover_cr, total_trades, week52_high, week52_low, technical_score, rsi, momentum_50d, relative_strength, trend_signal, trading_signal FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :as_of_date AND index_symbol IN (:index_symbols) ORDER BY trade_date, index_symbol

sql_templates.description: Read-only current snapshot for stage distribution, sector leadership, and candidate context.
sql_templates.name: stage_snapshot_current
sql_templates.template: SELECT snapshot_date, symbol, company_name, sector, market_cap_cat, price, live_price, price_date, change_1d_pct, change_1w_pct, change_1m_pct, stage, stage_score, technical_score, rsi, trend_signal, trading_signal, relative_strength, supertrend_state, supertrend_value, can_slim_score, minervini_score, fundamental_score, enhanced_fund_score, earnings_quality, sales_growth, financial_strength, institutional_backing, investment_score, stance, narrative, fund_details, source_csv FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = :as_of_date ORDER BY sector, symbol

sql_templates.description: Read-only baseline snapshot near the start of the 3-month window for stage distribution comparison.
sql_templates.name: stage_snapshot_baseline
sql_templates.template: SELECT snapshot_date, symbol, company_name, sector, market_cap_cat, price, live_price, price_date, change_1d_pct, change_1w_pct, change_1m_pct, stage, stage_score, technical_score, rsi, trend_signal, trading_signal, relative_strength, supertrend_state, supertrend_value, can_slim_score, minervini_score, fundamental_score, enhanced_fund_score, earnings_quality, sales_growth, financial_strength, institutional_backing, investment_score, stance, narrative, fund_details, source_csv FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = :baseline_snapshot_date ORDER BY sector, symbol

sql_templates.description: Read-only ranked Stage 2 VCP pick evidence for swing-candidate research.
sql_templates.name: stage2_vcp_current_picks
sql_templates.template: SELECT snapshot_date, rank, symbol, company_name, sector, price, live_price, price_date, change_1d_pct, change_1w_pct, rsi, relative_strength, trading_signal, trend_signal, supertrend_state, investment_score, enhanced_fund_score, earnings_quality, sales_growth, financial_strength, vcp_score, vcp_breakout_pct, vcp_contraction_pct, stance, narrative, fund_details, source_report, created_at, updated_at FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks WHERE snapshot_date = :as_of_date ORDER BY rank LIMIT :limit

sql_templates.description: Read-only EOD liquidity and price context for shortlisted NSE equity symbols.
sql_templates.name: candidate_equity_eod_liquidity
sql_templates.template: SELECT trade_date, symbol, series, open, high, low, close, last_price, prev_close, change_abs, change_pct, volume, turnover_cr, total_trades, delivery_qty, delivery_pct, week52_high, week52_low, market_cap_cr FROM market.equity_eod WHERE trade_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :as_of_date AND symbol IN (:candidate_symbols) AND series = 'EQ' ORDER BY symbol, trade_date

tool_plan_template.action: Set as_of_date to the user-provided date or latest available Indian market date. Set start_date to approximately 3 calendar months before as_of_date. If exact baseline snapshot is unavailable, use the nearest available snapshot_date on or before start_date and disclose it.
tool_plan_template.name: Resolve analysis dates

tool_plan_template.action: Fetch index EOD history over the window. Compare close, change_pct, rsi, momentum_50d, relative_strength, trend_signal, and trading_signal for major indices requested by the user or default Indian broad-market indices available in evidence.
tool_plan_template.name: Assess broad market regime

tool_plan_template.action: Fetch stage snapshots for as_of_date and baseline_snapshot_date. Count and compare stage values overall, by sector, and by market_cap_cat. Highlight expansion or contraction in Stage 2 participation.
tool_plan_template.name: Measure stage distribution shift

tool_plan_template.action: Use scores.stage_snapshots and scores.stage2_vcp_picks to rank sectors by Stage 2 breadth, average relative_strength, average technical_score, average investment_score, and concentration of ranked VCP picks. Treat this as leadership evidence, not a complete sector-index return calculation.

tool_plan_template.action: Start from scores.stage2_vcp_picks on as_of_date. description: Research-only Agent Adda Indian market screen to find NSE stocks showing Stage 2, VCP, breakout or near-new-high characteristics along with stronger fundamental, quality, and liquidity evidence.

evidence_gaps: True all-time-high detection is not available because only week52_high is present in the approved schema.
Intraday breakout confirmation, live order book strength, and tick-level volume expansion are not available in the approved schema.

Detailed VCP base anatomy such as number of contractions, base duration, pivot price, and dry-up volume sequence is not directly available unless reflected in vcp_score, vcp_breakout_pct, and vcp_contraction_pct.
Full fundamental statements, valuation ratios, promoter holding, pledge, FII/DII activity, and quarterly earnings line items are not available in the approved schema.

input_patterns: stocks creating new highs or VCP or breakouts with good fundamentals

latest_vcp_candidates.purpose: Fetch latest or user-specified Stage 2 VCP candidates with breakout and fundamental scores.
latest_vcp_candidates.template: SELECT snapshot_date, rank, symbol, company_name, sector, price, live_price, price_date, change_1d_pct, change_1w_pct, rsi, relative_strength, trading_signal, trend_signal, supertrend_state, investment_score, enhanced_fund_score, earnings_quality, sales_growth, financial_strength, vcp_score, vcp_breakout_pct, vcp_contraction_pct, stance, narrative, fund_details, source_report, created_at, updated_at FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks WHERE snapshot_date = COALESCE(:snapshot_date, (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)) AND vcp_score >= :min_vcp_score AND relative_strength >= :min_relative_strength AND enhanced_fund_score >= :min_enhanced_fund_score ORDER BY vcp_score DESC, investment_score DESC, relative_strength DESC LIMIT :limit

price_liquidity_new_high_context.purpose: Fetch EOD liquidity and near-52-week-high evidence for shortlisted symbols.
price_liquidity_new_high_context.template: SELECT trade_date, symbol, series, open, high, low, close, last_price, prev_close, change_abs, change_pct, volume, turnover_cr, total_trades, delivery_qty, delivery_pct, week52_high, week52_low, market_cap_cr FROM market.equity_eod WHERE trade_date = COALESCE(:trade_date, (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)) AND symbol IN (:symbols) AND series = :series AND close >= week52_high * :near_high_multiplier AND turnover_cr >= :min_turnover_cr AND volume >= :min_volume ORDER BY turnover_cr DESC, volume DESC, change_pct DESC

stage_and_fundamental_context.purpose: Fetch Stage 2, technical, and fundamental snapshot context for shortlisted symbols.
stage_and_fundamental_context.template: SELECT snapshot_date, symbol, company_name, sector, market_cap_cat, price, live_price, price_date, change_1d_pct, change_1w_pct, change_1m_pct, stage, stage_score, technical_score, rsi, trend_signal, trading_signal, relative_strength, supertrend_state, supertrend_value, can_slim_score, minervini_score, fundamental_score, enhanced_fund_score, earnings_quality, sales_growth, financial_strength, institutional_backing, investment_score, stance, narrative, fund_details, source_csv FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = COALESCE(:snapshot_date, (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)) AND symbol IN (:symbols) AND stage = :stage_filter ORDER BY investment_score DESC, technical_score DESC, enhanced_fund_score DESC

synthesis_guidance: {'tone': 'Concise Indian market research assistant; evidence-led and cautious.', 'ranking_logic': ['Prefer candidates present in scores.stage2_vcp_picks with higher vcp_score, higher investment_score, stronger relative_strength, and stronger enhanced_fund_score.', 'Prioritize Stage 2 names with constructive trading_signal, trend_signal, and supertrend_state when available.', 'Require liquidity support using turnover_cr and volume from market.equity_eod.', 'Treat close near week52_high as near-new-high evidence, not as all-time-high evidence.'], 'response_structure': ['State the filters and dates used.', 'Provide a compact candidate table.', 'List TradingView symbols as NSE:<symbol>.', 'Summarize the strongest evidence per candidate.', 'Call out evidence gaps and risks.', 'End with a research-only disclaimer.'], 'research_only_disclaimer': 'This Agent Adda output is for Indian equity market research only and is not investment advice, a recommendation, or a guarantee of future performance.'}

description: Research-only Agent Adda Indian market skill to review current portfolio holdings alongside point-in-time stage, technical, fundamental, and composite signals for incremental add or trim discussion.

evidence_gaps: No approved schema column for user risk profile, investment horizon, target allocation, benchmark weights, realized gains, taxes, liquidity needs, or cash balance.
No approved schema column for corporate actions, pledged promoter holding, mutual fund ownership changes, FII or DII flows, earnings dates, news events, or analyst estimates.
No approved schema column for portfolio-level realized or unrealized profit and loss after fees, brokerage, slippage, or taxes.
No approved schema column for sector classification history beyond the current sector field in scores.stage_snapshots.

portfolio position sizing by sector and stock
review holdings for add trim decisions

add_candidate_evidence.description: Read-only query to rank existing holdings by stronger available stage, technical, fundamental, and investment evidence for incremental-add research review.
add_candidate_evidence.sql: SELECT portfolio.holdings.symbol, portfolio.holdings.qty, portfolio.holdings.avg_cost, portfolio.holdings.buy_date, scores.stage_snapshots.snapshot_date, scores.stage_snapshots.company_name, scores.stage_snapshots.sector, scores.stage_snapshots.market_cap_cat, scores.stage_snapshots.live_price, scores.stage_snapshots.change_1w_pct, scores.stage_snapshots.change_1m_pct, scores.stage_snapshots.stage, scores.stage_snapshots.stage_score, scores.stage_snapshots.technical_score, scores.stage_snapshots.rsi, scores.stage_snapshots.trend_signal, scores.stage_snapshots.trading_signal, scores.stage_snapshots.relative_strength, scores.stage_snapshots.supertrend_state, scores.stage_snapshots.can_slim_score, scores.stage_snapshots.minervini_score, scores.stage_snapshots.fundamental_score, scores.stage_snapshots.enhanced_fund_score, scores.stage_snapshots.earnings_quality, scores.stage_snapshots.sales_growth, scores.stage_snapshots.financial_strength, scores.stage_snapshots.institutional_backing, scores.stage_snapshots.investment_score, scores.stage_snapshots.stance, scores.stage_snapshots.narrative, scores.stage_snapshots.fund_details FROM portfolio.holdings JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ON portfolio.holdings.symbol = scores.stage_snapshots.symbol WHERE scores.stage_snapshots.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) ORDER BY scores.stage_snapshots.investment_score DESC, scores.stage_snapshots.stage_score DESC, scores.stage_snapshots.technical_score DESC, scores.stage_snapshots.fundamental_score DESC

current_holdings_latest_snapshot.description: Read-only query for current holdings joined to the latest available stage snapshot.
current_holdings_latest_snapshot.sql: SELECT portfolio.holdings.symbol, portfolio.holdings.qty, portfolio.holdings.avg_cost, portfolio.holdings.buy_date, scores.stage_snapshots.snapshot_date, scores.stage_snapshots.company_name, scores.stage_snapshots.sector, scores.stage_snapshots.market_cap_cat, scores.stage_snapshots.price, scores.stage_snapshots.live_price, scores.stage_snapshots.price_date, scores.stage_snapshots.change_1d_pct, scores.stage_snapshots.change_1w_pct, scores.stage_snapshots.change_1m_pct, scores.stage_snapshots.stage, scores.stage_snapshots.stage_score, scores.stage_snapshots.technical_score, scores.stage_snapshots.rsi, scores.stage_snapshots.trend_signal, scores.stage_snapshots.trading_signal, scores.stage_snapshots.relative_strength, scores.stage_snapshots.supertrend_state, scores.stage_snapshots.supertrend_value, scores.stage_snapshots.can_slim_score, scores.stage_snapshots.minervini_score, scores.stage_snapshots.fundamental_score, scores.stage_snapshots.enhanced_fund_score, scores.stage_snapshots.earnings_quality, scores.stage_snapshots.sales_growth, scores.stage_snapshots.financial_strength, scores.stage_snapshots.institutional_backing, scores.stage_snapshots.investment_score, scores.stage_snapshots.stance, scores.stage_snapshots.narrative, scores.stage_snapshots.fund_details, scores.stage_snapshots.source_csv FROM portfolio.holdings JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ON portfolio.holdings.symbol = scores.stage_snapshots.symbol WHERE scores.stage_snapshots.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) ORDER BY scores.stage_snapshots.sector, portfolio.holdings.symbol

sector_exposure_latest_snapshot.description: Read-only query for sector-level exposure from current holdings using approved quantity, average cost, live price, and sector columns.
sector_exposure_latest_snapshot.sql: SELECT scores.stage_snapshots.sector, COUNT(portfolio.holdings.symbol), SUM(portfolio.holdings.qty), SUM(portfolio.holdings.qty * portfolio.holdings.avg_cost), SUM(portfolio.holdings.qty * scores.stage_snapshots.live_price) FROM portfolio.holdings JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ON portfolio.holdings.symbol = scores.stage_snapshots.symbol WHERE scores.stage_snapshots.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) GROUP BY scores.stage_snapshots.sector ORDER BY SUM(portfolio.holdings.qty * scores.stage_snapshots.live_price) DESC

trim_candidate_evidence.description: Read-only query to rank existing holdings by weaker available stage, technical, fundamental, and investment evidence for trim or risk-reduction research review.
trim_candidate_evidence.sql: SELECT portfolio.holdings.symbol, portfolio.holdings.qty, portfolio.holdings.avg_cost, portfolio.holdings.buy_date, scores.stage_snapshots.snapshot_date, scores.stage_snapshots.company_name, scores.stage_snapshots.sector, scores.stage_snapshots.market_cap_cat, scores.stage_snapshots.live_price, scores.stage_snapshots.change_1d_pct, scores.stage_snapshots.change_1w_pct, scores.stage_snapshots.change_1m_pct, scores.stage_snapshots.stage, scores.stage_snapshots.stage_score, scores.stage_snapshots.technical_score, scores.stage_snapshots.rsi, scores.stage_snapshots.trend_signal, scores.stage_snapshots.trading_signal, scores.stage_snapshots.relative_strength, scores.stage_snapshots.supertrend_state, scores.stage_snapshots.can_slim_score, scores.stage_snapshots.minervini_score, scores.stage_snapshots.fundamental_score, scores.stage_snapshots.enhanced_fund_score, scores.stage_snapshots.earnings_quality, scores.stage_snapshots.sales_growth, scores.stage_snapshots.financial_strength, scores.stage_snapshots.institutional_backing, scores.stage_snapshots.investment_score, scores.stage_snapshots.stance, scores.stage_snapshots.narrative, scores.stage_snapshots.fund_details FROM portfolio.holdings JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ON portfolio.holdings.symbol = scores.stage_snapshots.symbol WHERE scores.stage_snapshots.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) ORDER BY scores.stage_snapshots.investment_score ASC, scores.stage_snapshots.stage_score ASC, scores.stage_snapshots.technical_score ASC, scores.stage_snapshots.fundamental_score ASC

description: Research-only Agent Adda skill for Indian market report QA. Validates enhanced report run metadata and filtered Indian equity rows for completeness, consistency, and source-trail limitations using only approved report tables.

evidence_gaps: No approved table or column contains generated report URLs, link targets, file paths, HTTP status, or HTML document contents, so broken link detection cannot be proven from SQL evidence.
No approved table or column contains per-stock source trail URLs, scraped page text, or HTML payloads, so source trail and underlying stock HTML population checks require external non-SQL evidence.

validate generated report links and missing data

sql_templates.duplicate_ranks: SELECT run_id, rank, COUNT(rank) FROM report.enhanced_filtered_stocks WHERE run_id = :run_id GROUP BY run_id, rank HAVING COUNT(rank) > 1 ORDER BY rank
sql_templates.duplicate_symbols: SELECT run_id, symbol, COUNT(symbol) FROM report.enhanced_filtered_stocks WHERE run_id = :run_id GROUP BY run_id, symbol HAVING COUNT(symbol) > 1 ORDER BY symbol
sql_templates.filtered_rows_by_run_id: SELECT run_id, rank, symbol, score, recommendation, current_price, open_price, high_price, low_price, volume, trading_value_cr, weekly_signal, daily_signal, day_change_pct, rsi, above_50dma, above_200dma, tech_score, fund_score, rs_score, macd_signal, week52_position, volume_ratio, rs_vs_nifty500 FROM report.enhanced_filtered_stocks WHERE run_id = :run_id ORDER BY rank
sql_templates.missing_core_stock_data: SELECT run_id, rank, symbol, score, recommendation, current_price, volume, weekly_signal, daily_signal, tech_score, fund_score, rs_score FROM report.enhanced_filtered_stocks WHERE run_id = :run_id AND (rank IS NULL OR symbol IS NULL OR score IS NULL OR recommendation IS NULL OR current_price IS NULL OR volume IS NULL OR weekly_signal IS NULL OR daily_signal IS NULL OR tech_score IS NULL OR fund_score IS NULL OR rs_score IS NULL) ORDER BY rank
sql_templates.numeric_sanity_exceptions: SELECT run_id, rank, symbol, score, current_price, open_price, high_price, low_price, volume, trading_value_cr, day_change_pct, rsi, tech_score, fund_score, rs_score, volume_ratio FROM report.enhanced_filtered_stocks WHERE run_id = :run_id AND (score < 0 OR current_price < 0 OR open_price < 0 OR high_price < 0 OR low_price < 0 OR volume < 0 OR trading_value_cr < 0 OR rsi < 0 OR rsi > 100 OR tech_score < 0 OR fund_score < 0 OR rs_score < 0 OR volume_ratio < 0) ORDER BY rank
sql_templates.recent_runs: SELECT run_id, run_ts, analysis_date, universe_size, stocks_analyzed, stocks_filtered, indices_analyzed, market_composite_score, market_sentiment, notes FROM report.enhanced_runs ORDER BY run_ts DESC
sql_templates.run_metadata_by_run_id: SELECT run_id, run_ts, analysis_date, universe_size, stocks_analyzed, stocks_filtered, indices_analyzed, market_composite_score, market_sentiment, notes FROM report.enhanced_runs WHERE run_id = :run_id
sql_templates.run_row_count_reconciliation: SELECT report.enhanced_runs.run_id, report.enhanced_runs.analysis_date, report.enhanced_runs.stocks_filtered, COUNT(report.enhanced_filtered_stocks.symbol) FROM report.enhanced_runs LEFT JOIN report.enhanced_filtered_stocks ON report.enhanced_runs.run_id = report.enhanced_filtered_stocks.run_id WHERE report.enhanced_runs.run_id = :run_id GROUP BY report.enhanced_runs.run_id, report.enhanced_runs.analysis_date, report.enhanced_runs.stocks_filtered

Inspect filtered stock rows for missing core fields: rank, symbol, score, recommendation, current_price, volume, weekly_signal, daily_signal, tech_score, fund_score, and rs_score.
Check numeric sanity for Indian equity research reporting, including non-negative prices, volume, trading_value_cr, and scores where populated.
Check rank sequencing and duplicate symbol evidence for the target run_id using approved filtered stock rows.
Report broken_links only as unverified or evidence-gapped unless separate non-database evidence is supplied, because approved SQL evidence does not include URLs, paths, HTTP status, or HTML bodies.
Frame all outputs as research-only QA findings for Agent Adda Indian market reports, not investment advice or trading instructions.
validation_rules: status must remain generated.
Use only evidence_required.tables and approved columns when forming SQL or evidence claims.
All SQL templates must be read-only SELECT/WITH statements and must not modify data.
Do not claim a report link is broken solely from approved SQL evidence, because link URLs, file paths, HTTP status, and HTML contents are not present in the approved schema.
Flag link and HTML checks as evidence gaps unless non-SQL evidence is provided by the caller.
Treat a mismatch between report.enhanced_runs.stocks_filtered and the count of report.enhanced_filtered_stocks rows for the run_id as a data reconciliation finding.
Treat missing symbol, rank, score, recommendation, current_price, volume, weekly_signal, daily_signal, tech_score, fund_score, or rs_score as missing_data findings for filtered stock rows.
Treat negative price, volume, trading_value_cr, score, tech_score, fund_score, rs_score, or volume_ratio values as numeric sanity exceptions.
Treat rsi values below 0 or above 100 as numeric sanity exceptions.
Treat duplicate symbol or duplicate rank values within the same run_id as report QA findings.
Keep synthesis research-only and Indian-market framed; do not provide buy, sell, or hold instructions beyond describing stored recommendation values as report data.
